title: Standardize task mutation error mapping for malformed-record safety
description:
Problem: malformed task fallback records are intentionally non-editable, but task mutation API endpoints do not consistently map `ArgumentException` to client-safe 4xx responses. This can still surface as HTTP 500 on specific mutation paths.

Desired outcome: all task mutation endpoints return consistent, explicit client error contracts (4xx + ProblemDetails/code) when operations are blocked by malformed task state or other validation failures.

Scope:
- In scope: align endpoint exception handling across status, attachment removal, delete, and other mutation paths; add shared mapping helper/middleware pattern; add regression tests using malformed task fixtures.
- Out of scope: full redesign of task API surface.

Acceptance criteria:
- No task mutation endpoint returns 500 for malformed-task edit attempts.
- Validation and malformed-state failures produce stable 4xx envelopes.
- Regression suite verifies each mutation endpoint behavior for malformed records.

Validation:
- Add integration tests for each mutation route against malformed fallback task data.
- Confirm response contracts and status codes are consistent and documented.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from continued audit finding C-007 on inconsistent task mutation exception mapping.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Phase 1 complete: standardized ArgumentException->BadRequest mapping for task mutation endpoints (status/remove-attachment/delete) and added regression tests for malformed-task mutation behavior.
